# R7.8 — Open-deferral sweep: machinery repairs + dispositions + records hygiene (manifest 341)

Disposition: **done — executed, offline (USD $0.00)**. The sweep
dispositioned all eight open deferral rows: five machinery repairs
landed in the p4c/p4x drivers + `gce-backend.sh` each with a
regression fixture that fails without it; four rows CLOSED on the
repairs plus one on the H21 billing reconcile; two rows carry dated
notings of exactly what remains; one row (DF-R7.1-2) carries forward
untouched — its unblocker is R7.9's own subject.

- Gate envelope: none — offline records/machinery ticket (depends on
  GATE-G38, chain order only). PR #424 merge `cd0e696e` pushed
  (merge stays the operator's act).
- Requirement IDs: REQ-XD-104 (fold semantics — ADR-0455 drafted,
  not landed), REQ-XB/REQ-XH machinery ids each row cites.

## Repairs (each + regression fixture)

1. **DF-R7.5-1 — resume-safe session/probe artifacts.** Both drivers
   (`p4c-main-driver.py`, `p4x-main-driver.py`) gained
   `session_artifact_paths(out_dir, run_id)`: session
   `proxy-session-<rid>.json`, sentinel `proxy-<rid>.sentinel`, log
   `proxy-session-<rid>.log`, probe `lane-probe-<rid>.json`, keyed on
   the sanitized `run_id`; `--window-name`/`--checkpoint-name` now
   default to run_id-keyed spellings. `archive_stale_session`
   byte-archives a same-run stale file to `<file>.stale-<epoch_ms>`
   (`os.replace`, contents untouched) and refuses byte-untouched on a
   `run_id` mismatch → `provision_refused{stale_session:run_id_mismatch}`
   (launch leg) and `provision_refused{session_run_id_mismatch}`
   (provision-poll leg) — never a false lane-wide hold. Fixture
   `test_p4c_main_driver.py::SessionArtifactFixture` (7 legs:
   keyed paths, sanitized rid, same-run archive byte-untouched,
   mismatched-run_id refuse byte-untouched, prior-window artifacts
   verbatim under a fresh keyed provision — the row's named verify
   fixture) + `test_p4x_main_driver.py` mirror. → **CLOSED**.
2. **DF-R7.5-2 — slot-container memory bound (declared + wired).**
   `--slot-memory-mb` (default 6144 = the declaration's
   `concurrency.memory_per_trial_gib: 6` on e2-standard-8's 26 GiB
   under C = 4) rides `connection_info.cell_spec` →
   `ext["cell_spec"]` → `PodmanBackend::create_args --memory <mb>m`
   (the hh-env/hh-helper plumbing pre-existed; both drivers + the
   verify clone arm it; `arm.json` records `applied_limits`).
   Fixtures pin the wiring (`MemoryBoundFixture` — cell_spec present
   at 6144, absent at 0; `VerifyCellFixture` — `--memory 6144m` on
   the verify run argv). The row's behavioral verify leg — a
   synthetic hog OOM-killed inside its cgroup while the guest keeps
   ens4/journald alive — needs a live leg or a container fixture; no
   podman machine exists in this environment (`podman machine list`
   empty). → **stays OPEN** with a dated noting (bound
   declared-and-wired, not yet kill-evidenced).
3. **DF-CAP7.1-1 — post-window cost reconciliation.** `reconcile_costs`
   runs after session seal (sentinel + `shim.wait`), recomputing each
   settled slot's `cost_micros` from the sealed WAL via the existing
   `slot_cost_micros`; non-resume-seeded committed `slot-result.json`
   is rewritten to the WAL sum carrying
   `cost_snapshot{class:cost_snapshot{approximate}, reap_micros,
   reconciled_micros, residual_micros}`; resume-seeded results stay
   byte-untouched (`prior{byte_untouched}` on the window row only);
   the window record gains
   `cost_reconciliation{class:measurement.cost.reconciled, rows[]}` in
   the second seal pass. Fixture `CostReconcileFixture` (late-landing
   attributed events → committed record = WAL recompute; zero-residual
   slots verbatim; prior-seeded labeled never rewritten) + p4x
   mirror. → **CLOSED**.
4. **DF-CAP7.1-2 — run-keyed verify-cell names + bounded retry.**
   `verify_tag(run_id, slot_id)` = sha256(`<run_id>/<slot_id>`)[:16]
   for `hh-verify-<tag>`/`hh-verify-run-<tag>`; `podman rm -f`
   pre-clean before each verify launch; bounded two-attempt retry on
   rc-125 `already in use`; a persisting collision mints
   `verifier_unavailable{container_conflict}` — never bare rc-125.
   Fixture `VerifyCellFixture` (conflict-then-clean → `recorded`
   after exactly two run attempts; persistent → the typed refusal;
   tag differs across run_ids and from the pre-fix slot-only form) +
   p4x tag fixture. → **CLOSED**.
5. **DF-R7.3-4(a) — marker-resolved harvest root.** The driver stamps
   `last-run-root-<window.lower()>` beside the run roots at launch
   carrying the absolute recorded `--out` path
   (`stamp_run_root_marker`). `gce-backend.sh` `harvest_impl` resolves
   `rroot` via `cat /var/lib/hh/runs/last-run-root-$WINDOW` gated to
   the `/var/lib/hh/runs/*` prefix (fallback `run-root-$WINDOW` on
   absent/foreign marker); the remote `mkdir -p` is removed so a
   missing root fails closed at `cd` instead of minting a
   trivially-verified empty directory (the X1 loss class). Leg (b)
   landed at R7.5 — both unblocker legs discharged. Regression:
   check-gce-backend `diverge.json` (window `w9d`, marker →
   `run-root-p4x`) asserts the manifest+tar runs
   `cd "/var/lib/hh/runs/run-root-p4x"` and no `mkdir -p` mints the
   root — legs 72–74 of the 121-check battery. → **CLOSED**.

    checker gained a **rowed-exception** mechanism

    defect's permanent-disposition question for an operator ruling.
    `check-compute-receipts.sh` → **OK** (132 receipts + 30 cost
    records + 31 declarations valid, 1 excepted rowed).
